subject: Physics
subtopic: Orbital motion and time period of satellites
stem: A satellite is orbiting just above the surface of the earth with period \( T \). If \( d \) is the density of the earth and \( G \) is the universal constant of gravitation, the quantity \( \dfrac{3\pi}{Gd} \) represents
solution:
Time period of satellite above earth surface
\[ T = 2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{R^3}{GM}} = 2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{R^3}{Gd\,\dfrac{4}{3}\pi R^3}} \]
\[ T = 2\pi\sqrt{\dfrac{3}{4\pi Gd}} \]
\[ T = \sqrt{\dfrac{3\pi}{Gd}} \qquad T^2 = \dfrac{3\pi}{Gd} \]

subject: Physics
subtopic: Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field
stem: A straight wire of length \( L \) carrying a current \( I \) is placed along the \( x \)-axis in a uniform magnetic field \( \vec{B} = (2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 4\hat{k})\ \text{T} \). The magnitude of the magnetic force acting on the wire is
solution:
Magnetic force acting on a current carrying wire is
\[ \vec{F} = I\vec{\ell} \times \vec{B} \]
\[ = IL\hat{i} \times (2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}) = 3IL\hat{k} + 4IL\hat{j} \]
Magnitude of force
\[ |\vec{F}| = \sqrt{(3IL)^2 + (4IL)^2} = 5IL \]

subject: Physics
stem: The resistance of platinum wire at \( 0^\circ\text{C} \) is \( 2\ \Omega \) and \( 6.8\ \Omega \) at \( 80^\circ\text{C} \). The temperature coefficient of resistance of the wire is
solution:
Using \( R = R_0(1 + \alpha\Delta T) \)
where \( \alpha \) is the thermal coefficient of resistance
\[ 6.8 = 2\{1 + \alpha(80 - 0)\} \]
\[ \dfrac{6.8}{2} - 1 = \alpha \times 80 \]
\[ \alpha = \dfrac{3.4 - 1}{80} = \dfrac{2.4}{80} = 0.03 \]
\[ \therefore \alpha = 3 \times 10^{-2}\ ^\circ\text{C}^{-1} \]

subject: Physics
stem: A horizontal bridge is built across a river. A student standing on the bridge throws a small ball vertically upwards with a velocity \( 4\ \text{m s}^{-1} \). The ball strikes the water surface after 4 s. The height of bridge above water surface is (Take \( g = 10\ \text{m s}^{-2} \))
solution:
\[ s = ut - \dfrac{1}{2}gt^2 \]
\[ = 16 - \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 16 \]
\[ = -64\ \text{m} \]
Height of bridge above water surface \( = 64\ \text{m} \)
